description:
Title: Web Developer (Internet Web Engineer) 
 Location: Columbia SC 
 Duration: 12 months 
 10+ years experience in Medicaid systems, specializing in web development, required. 
 Scope of project: 
 The software engineer is responsible for assessing, designing, developing, implementing, and supporting the client services effort and any other projects, as assigned. The position will be a part of a production support group.

 Required skills (rank in order of importance): 
 Java
 Web Development (Tapestry, HTML, JavaScript, Jquery)
 Web Services (REST, SOAP, WSDL)
 EDI Transaction Sets (270/271, 276/277, 837)
 ActiveMQ
 SQL and Stored Procedures
 Spring Security
 JDBC
 Unix Environment/scripting
 Preferred skills (rank in order of importance): 
 Medicaid eligibility.
 Medicaid management information system (MMIS).
 Medicaid operations.
 
 
 

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
